name: api-vampi
description: VAmPI (erev0s/vampi), a deliberately vulnerable API. Ground truth is VAmPI's OWN documented vulnerability list (9 classes, from its README) — NOT derived from what our tools happen to emit, which would be circular. Target is the BASE URL, not the spec: openapi_spec_ingest discovers /openapi.json from commonSpecPaths and emits the SPEC marker that PlanFanout needs to dispatch schemathesis. Deploy: docker run -d -p 5002:5000 -e vulnerable=1 erev0s/vampi

competitors.note: No neutral API-security leaderboard exists (unlike WAVSEP/OWASP-Benchmark). VAmPI + crAPI are the community reference targets; recall here is against the SUT's own documented vulnerability list.

ground_truth_note: VAmPI documents 9 deliberate vulnerabilities. must_find carries ONE token per detectable class (was two spellings of SQLi, which capped recall at 0.5 for a single class — a ground-truth bug, not an engine miss). It carries only the classes an L1 api scan can currently surface, because a fixture that can never pass is a permanently-red gate rather than a measurement. The full denominator is recorded here so the gap stays visible instead of being quietly defined away — the same failure the WAVSEP scorer had when unreached cases were graded as misses.
